subject: client_config_keys
claim: On r806919, config.xml carries 9 tables: 8 single-record tables holding 96 keys, plus InputMappings with 143 records in 4 record schemas; preferences.xml carries 5 tables holding 26 keys. Every key name and value type is inventoried in the evidence; observed values come from a used install, so fresh-install defaults must be re-derived.
how_to_repeat: Read config.xml and preferences.xml from your own r806919 install (web client).
Parse each table's single RECORD (every table except InputMappings) and list each child key with its TYPE attribute.
For InputMappings, group the 143 RECORDs by their field schema and record each schema's fields and bindings.
Compare the table list, key names and types against the evidence below.

Observed values come from a used r806919 web-client install (1366x768); installation-specific keys observed: config.xml GameSettings.LastPlayer (GID, a player id); plausibly user-modified: VideoSettings.Resolution and VideoSettings.IsFullscreen (both files). Fresh-install defaults must be re-derived by the maintainer from a fresh install.

No duplicate keys in any single-record table; every table named in _TableList exists in its file (9/9 in config.xml, 5/5 in preferences.xml); types observed beyond INT/STR/FLT/UINT: BYT, UBYT, GID, WSTR.
disproof: A parse of config.xml and preferences.xml from another r806919 install showing a different table, a missing or extra key in any table, or a different TYPE for any key.
